messages:
mira: FYI I ran an initial bring-up for Callisto10b with fp16/int8/int4 variants. Need a short cost-vs-quality recommendation and a tiny routing flag we can hand to infra/PMs.

kevin: Quick smoke numbers (30k token sample): p95: fp16=140ms, int8=125ms, int4=112ms. Throughput +12% on int4. Rough unit costs (inc batching + conservative cache): fp16 $0.0016/token, int8 $0.00095/token, int4 $0.00056/token.

tara-qa: Quality snapshot: on our longform QA slice (>512 tokens) EM deltas vs fp16: int8 -1.4pt, int4 -5.9pt. Hallucination rate increases mainly for retrieval-dependent items on int4 (+2.4ppt). Short completions <=48 tokens show <0.7pt EM drift.

jon: Practical recommendation for GTN: make int8 the platform default (best balance). Enable int4 as an explicit opt-in for low-risk, short-prompt flows (e.g., status snippets, categorical replies). Block int4 from retrieval-heavy or longform routes until we have mitigations.

mira: What mitigations should we try before widening int4?

kevin: Two immediate levers: 1) KV-cache warmstart for primed flows (recovers priming cost + reduces token churn). 2) Small mixed-precision variant (keep first 2 and last 2 transformer blocks in int8, middle blocks int4) — bench that variant to see EM recovery vs cost.

tara-qa: Canary test plan: slices = [short snippets <=48, multi-turn assistant history=3, longform QA >512]. Metrics: exact-match, hallucination rate, p95 latency, token-cost delta. AB run 24h; auto-alert if EM drop >2% on any primary slice.

jon: Minimal routing flag proto (hand-off):
```json
{
  "routing": [
    {"id":"short_lowcost","match":"tokens<=48 && metadata.risk=='low'","model":"callisto10b-int4","sample_rate":0.05},
    {"id":"default","model":"callisto10b-int8","sample_rate":0.94},
    {"id":"fp16_fallback","model":"callisto10b-fp16","sample_rate":0.01}
  ],
  "fallbacks": [
    {"from":"callisto10b-int4","to":"callisto10b-int8","triggers":["quality_drop","latency_spike"]}
  ]
}
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Proposed canary to eng-dedicated-callisto tomorrow 04:00 UTC, 2h window. Canary split: int4 sample 5% on short_lowcost. Rollback triggers: EM regression >2% or p95 latency increase >25%.

mira: GTN one-liner I can share: "Recommend callisto10b-int8 as default for production (best cost-quality tradeoff). Offer callisto10b-int4 as a controlled opt-in for short, low-risk flows to capture ~35-40% unit-cost savings vs fp16; keep int8/fp16 for longform/retrieval-critical routes until mitigations validate quality parity."

tara-qa: I'll upload CSV and pivot after the overnight AB. If int4 causes >2% EM loss on any longform slice during canary, we rollback and iterate on mixed-precision.

kevin: I'll spin up the mixed-per-layer trial on bench and report delta vs int4/int8 tomorrow.

mira: Thanks everyone. Action items: kevin = mixed-per-layer job + add cache toggles to PR, jon = open routing-flag PR, tara = run AB and post artifacts, I'll monitor canary. Ping when PR link is ready. :thumbsup:
